title: select preselect settings not questions
rule: Select: pre-select for settings; do not pre-select for questions (influence). Dual-cite with NN/g always-default-radio (via explicit None) and Polar default-when-possible — not a winner.
pass_when: Question select/radio: no silent preselected answer; if “none” is valid, an explicit None is in the set. Settings: the current or safe value is selected.
fail_when: A question silently preselects a guessed answer; or a settings control has a logical current/safe value and leaves it unselected; or a global “always/never preselect” with no question-vs-settings split.
overview: Pre-select on settings; do not silently pre-select answers on questions.
apply_when: Deciding defaults for selects or radios on questions versus settings.
not_when: Not for checkboxes that are independently multi-select without a single default.
agent_hint: Leave question answers unselected or use explicit None; pre-select settings’ current value.
description: On questions, do not silently preselect a guessed answer; if none is valid, include an explicit None. On settings, select the current or safe value so the control reflects reality. The question-versus-settings split matters: silent defaults influence answers on questions but help on settings. Fail if a question silently preselects a guess, a settings control leaves a logical current value unselected, or a global always/never preselect ignores that split. Apply when deciding defaults for selects or radios.
do_not_claim: Forcing a guessed question answer to satisfy “always default a radio”. Overlap with Forms 54: `forms.inputs.good_defaults_smart_prefills`. Encode question vs settings; do not collapse into Tidwell Good Defaults.
